title: Import Price Matches Formula
description: A shipment created via the CSV side door skips the quote wizard entirely, but its price still has to come out of the exact same pricing math a customer would have seen — not a shortcut, not a rough estimate.
successCondition: Import one CSV row with specific, known weightKg/lengthCm/widthCm/heightCm and origin/destination coordinates. Independently call POST /api/booking/quote with the identical origin/destination/package to get the "expected" priceCents and distanceKm. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` for the imported row confirms price_cents and distance_km exactly equal the quote's values — the import path (apps/api/src/modules/admin/service.ts's importShipmentsCsv) reuses the same calculateQuote function, not a re-derived approximation.
hints: Pick a package where volumetric weight (lengthCm*widthCm*heightCm/5000) actually exceeds the raw weightKg, so you're also confirming the chargeableWeight branch of the formula, not just the simple case.
Required CSV columns and quoting rules for labels containing commas are documented in docs/api/admin.md.
